(fadrozole) Profile Fadrozole hydrochloride is a selective nonsteroidal inhibitor of the aromatase (oestrogen synthetase) system, similar to anastro- zole (p.681). It is used for the treatment of breast cancer. It has been given in oral doses of 1 mg twice daily. ◊ References. 1. Buzdar AU, et al.
